name: Galeed
line: Galeed is the name of a mound of stones where Jacob and Laban made a promise of peace, with God as their witness.

moments.title: A mound of witness
moments.text: Jacob told his relatives to gather stones, and they made a mound and ate there. Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed, which means heap of witness.

moments.title: A promise of peace
moments.text: Laban said the mound and the pillar were witnesses that neither man would pass them to harm the other. Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
